sources.title: GitHub - bdd100k/bdd100k: Toolkit of BDD100K Dataset for Heterogeneous ...
sources.snippet: We construct BDD100K, the largest open driving video dataset with 100K videos and 10 tasks to evaluate the exciting progress of image recognition algorithms on autonomous driving. Each video has 40 seconds and a high resolution. The dataset represents more than 1000 hours of driving experience with more than 100 million frames.

sources.title: BDD100K: A Diverse Driving Dataset for Heterogeneous Multitask Learning
sources.snippet: The tasks can be formulated as pixel-level or low-dimensional classification and regression. BDD100K contains multiple tasks including pixel-level, region-based, and temporally aware tasks, opening the door for heterogeneous multitask learning.
